records.text: Dr. Peter McCullough recommends doing a parasite cleanse at least once a year as a preventative measure. The wellness company offers a hard-to-access Rx Parasite Cleanse, U.S. compounded ivermectin and memendazole, which paralyzes the parasite's nervous system, then starves.
